title: Newmark Pacific Arranges Lease on Behalf of Noble Ace at Historic Heisler Building in Downtown Laguna Beach, California
summary: Newmark Pacific announces the Company has facilitated a lease for historic Heisler Building, a 6,654-square-foot property in the heart of Downtown Laguna Beach, California.
body_markdown: Newmark Pacific announces the Company has facilitated a lease for historic Heisler Building, a 6,654-square-foot property in the heart of Downtown Laguna Beach, California.
